mikrotik_produktseite.kurztext: Outdoor 5GHz 802.11a/n/ac wireless device with a backfire type 21dBi integrated antenna and Gigabit Ethernet for longer distances
mikrotik_produktseite.beschreibung: DISC Lite5 ac is equipped with 21 dBi dual chain antenna, 802.11a/n/ac integrated wireless, 716 MHz CPU, 256 MB RAM, 1x Gigabit Ethernet port and RouterOS Level 3 license. It comes complete with a power supply, Gigabit PoE injector and a mounting ring. The device is also compatible with our SXT mounting systems, including the quickMOUNT pro series.
varianten: DISC Lite5 ac-US (USA) is factory locked for 5170-5250MHz and 5725-5835MHz frequencies. This lock can not be removed.

mikrotik_handbuch.Beschreibung: outdoor wireless system with a built-in directional antenna. It can be used as a CPE or for Point to Point links.
mikrotik_handbuch.Montage: This product is intended to be mounted outdoors on a pole. ... metal mounting ring, which can be used on either side of the product (two mounting slots available). The third, central mount point is compatible with the quickMount Pro (not included).
mikrotik_handbuch.Powering: The device only accepts 10-30 V power from Passive PoE injectors (one power supply and PoE injector are included).
mikrotik_handbuch.Extension slots and ports: One 10/100 Ethernet port, supporting automatic cross/straight cable correction (Auto MDI/X) ...; One Integrated Wireless 5GHz 802.11a/n or ac (depending on model), 2x2 MIMO with a built-in directional antenna, max gain 21 dBi.
mikrotik_handbuch.Reset button: Hold during boot until LED flashing: reset RouterOS configuration (5 s); +5 s LED solid: CAP mode (10 s); +5 s LED off: Netinstall (15 s). Pressed before power is applied: backup RouterBOOT loader.
Accessories: DC ⎓ EU/US Switching Power Supply 24 V, 0.38 A, 9 W, Level VI, cable:1.5 m.
POE Injector cable (POE) / Gigabit POE injector (GPOE).
